songs.title: NeonDriveRetro
songs.sp: Synthwave, nostalgic neon-lit energy, analog synthesizer arpeggios and DX7 electric piano, no vocals. Pulsing 16th-note arpeggio pattern drives the entire track at 118 BPM in the key of A minor. Gated reverb on snare hits 2 and 4, deep analog kick drum with sidechain on the bass synth. Juno-106 style warm pad sustained under the arpeggio. Bassline is a mono synth with portamento sliding between root notes. No modern production — vintage analog warmth throughout, slight tape hiss on the master bus. Build from minimal intro arpeggio to full arrangement with layered synth leads. Outro: arpeggio alone fading with increasing delay feedback.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Intro - 8 bars]
Arpeggio alone, reverb trail

[Verse 1 - 16 bars]
Full kit enters, bass synth joins

[Chorus - 16 bars]
Synth lead melody soars above

[Bridge - 8 bars]
Breakdown, filter sweep on bass

[Chorus 2 - 16 bars]
Layered leads, maximum energy

[Outro - 8 bars]
Arpeggio fades with delay

songs.title: SouthLondonNights
songs.sp: UK Drill, dark menacing energy, sliding 808 bass and minor-key piano, aggressive male rapper. 140 BPM in D minor. Rolling hi-hat triplet patterns with ghost notes, heavy plate reverb on snare. 808 sub-bass with downward pitch slides on every other bar. Sparse dark piano melody in minor key, single notes with long decay. No autotune — raw authentic delivery. Atmospheric dark pad underneath. Mix is bass-heavy with the 808 dominating the low end. Structure: intro pad into beat drop, verse-hook-verse-hook-outro.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro - 4 bars]
Dark pad, distant siren sample

[Verse 1]
Concrete jungle after dark
Sliding through the city streets
Every corner tells a story
Bass hits heavy on repeat

[Hook]
South London nights, cold air bites
Streetlights flicker, shadows move

[Verse 2]
Rolling with the rhythm now
Hi-hats spinning triple time
Piano keys paint pictures dark
Every word falls into line

[Hook]
South London nights, cold air bites
Streetlights flicker, shadows move

[Outro - 4 bars]
Beat fades, pad remains

songs.sp: Amapiano, smooth deep groove, log-drum bassline and slick piano chords, no vocals. 112 BPM in F major. Deep rolling shaker, soft Rhodes piano chords, sub-bass log drum pattern.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Intro - 8 bars]

[Verse - 16 bars]

[Drop - 16 bars]

[Bridge - 8 bars]

[Drop 2 - 16 bars]

[Outro - 8 bars]

songs.title: DembowCaliente
songs.sp: Reggaeton, fiery dance energy, dembow rhythm and deep booming bass, confident sultry female vocalist. 95 BPM in G minor. Classic dembow drum pattern with kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4, syncopated toms. Deep 808 booming bass following the kick pattern. Atmospheric synth pads with filter automation. Percussive clap layers on the hook. Vocal delivery is rhythmic and melodic with slight attitude. Mix is polished, bass-forward, stereo-wide on the synths.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro - 4 bars]
Dembow beat alone

[Verse 1]
Fuego en la pista tonight
Moving to the bassline right
Every beat drops like a wave
Dancing till the break of day

[Pre-Chorus]
Feel it rising, feel it now

[Chorus]
Caliente, caliente
The rhythm takes control
Caliente, caliente
Let the bass consume your soul

[Verse 2]
Lights go down the beat goes up
Every move electric touch
Dembow driving through the night
Everybody feeling right

[Chorus]
Caliente, caliente
The rhythm takes control

[Outro - 4 bars]
Beat breakdown, fade

songs.title: CrushingSludge
songs.sp: Doom Metal, crushing despairing atmosphere, downtuned sludge guitar riffs and massive distortion, growling male vocals. 65 BPM in Drop-B tuning, key of B minor. Extremely slow tempo with heavy sustain on power chords. Guitar tone is thick wall of fuzz and distortion. Bass guitar doubles the riff one octave lower with additional overdrive. Drums are slow and heavy — kick on 1, snare on 3, minimal hi-hat. No clean vocals — all delivery is low growl or scream. Reverb creates cavernous space. Build from single guitar drone to full crushing wall of sound.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro - 8 bars]
Feedback drone, single guitar note sustains

[Verse 1]
(growling)
Beneath the weight of endless stone
Crushing slow descent alone
The riff repeats its funeral march
Through caverns carved by time

[Riff - 8 bars]
Full band, slowest tempo

[Verse 2]
(screaming)
No light reaches this deep below
Only resonance of doom
The bass shakes foundations
Walls close in eternal

[Breakdown]
Slowest section, bass and drums only

[Outro]
Drone fades into silence

songs.title: LiquidRoller
songs.sp: Drum and Bass, liquid rolling energy, fast breakbeat drums and deep rolling sub-bass, no vocals. 174 BPM in E minor. No four-on-the-floor — syncopated breakbeat pattern with snare on offbeats, rapid hi-hat variations, ghost notes on kick. Rolling sub-bass with long sustained notes following the chord progression. Atmospheric warm pads in minor key with occasional major chord lifts. Rhodes piano melodic phrase repeating over the breaks. Reverb on the pads, dry and punchy on the drums. Intro builds from pad and single snare hits into full breakbeat drop.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Intro - 16 bars]
Pad atmosphere, building

[Drop 1 - 32 bars]
Full breakbeat, sub-bass enters

[Break - 16 bars]
Pad and Rhodes melody

[Drop 2 - 32 bars]
Maximum energy, layered breaks

[Outro - 16 bars]
Breakbeat strips back, pad fades

songs.title: BirdFliesAgain
songs.sp: Bebop jazz, virtuosic swinging energy, alto saxophone lead and walking upright bass, no vocals. 220 BPM in Bb major. No electric instruments — all acoustic. Alto saxophone plays rapid bebop lines with chromatic passing tones. Piano comping with sparse jazz voicings, occasional solo breaks. Upright bass walks quarter notes outlining chord changes. Drums: ride cymbal swing pattern, snare accents, brushes on hi-hat. Head-solo-head structure. Live recording feel with room ambience, no effects processing.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Head - 32 bars]
Saxophone states melody

[Solo 1 - 32 bars]
Saxophone improvisation

[Solo 2 - 32 bars]
Piano solo

[Solo 3 - 16 bars]
Bass solo walking

[Head Out - 32 bars]
Saxophone restates melody

[Tag - 4 bars]
Unison ending

songs.title: MountainPickin
songs.sp: Bluegrass, high-energy picking virtuosity, banjo lead and fiddle harmonies, no vocals. 145 BPM in G major. Five-string banjo playing Scruggs-style three-finger picking pattern as lead instrument. Fiddle doubles melody and adds harmony fills. Acoustic guitar flatpicking rhythm with bass runs between chords. Upright bass on beats 1 and 3, walking between chord tones. Mandolin chop on 2 and 4 for rhythmic drive. No drums — the mandolin chop and bass provide all the rhythm. Live acoustic recording feel, no reverb, room sound only.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Intro - 8 bars]
Banjo roll alone

[A Section - 16 bars]
Full band, banjo lead melody

[B Section - 16 bars]
Fiddle takes lead

[Solo - Banjo - 16 bars]

[Solo - Mandolin - 16 bars]

[A Section Reprise - 16 bars]
Banjo lead, full energy

[Tag - 4 bars]
Unison ending on G

songs.title: TinWhistleDawn
songs.sp: Celtic folk, gentle dawn energy rising to joyful dance, tin whistle lead and bodhran drum, no vocals. Starts at 90 BPM in D major, accelerates to 130 BPM for the reel section. Tin whistle plays Irish air melody in first half, transitioning to jig then reel. Bodhran provides pulse with tipper technique. Acoustic guitar fingerpicking arpeggios underneath. Fiddle enters halfway adding harmony and countermelody. Uilleann pipes drone sustains in background. Arrangement grows from solo whistle to full ensemble. Natural reverb only, intimate cottage recording feel.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Air - 16 bars]
Tin whistle alone, slow and lyrical

[Jig - 16 bars]
Bodhran enters, tempo increases

[Reel - 32 bars]
Full ensemble, fast and joyful

[Bridge - 8 bars]
Fiddle solo over drone

[Reel 2 - 32 bars]
Maximum energy, all instruments

[Outro - 8 bars]
Slows back to air, whistle alone

songs.title: DjangoAfterDark
songs.sp: Gypsy jazz, hot swinging late-night energy, acoustic guitar lead and violin, no vocals. 190 BPM in D minor. No drums, no percussion kit — rhythm comes from two acoustic guitars playing la pompe rhythm (percussive jazz strumming on 2 and 4). Lead guitar plays rapid single-note lines with Django Reinhardt chromatic approach. Violin adds harmony lines and occasional double-stop fills. Upright bass walks quarter notes. All acoustic, all live feel. No effects, no reverb — close-mic dry recording. Minor key with diminished chord turnarounds.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Head - 32 bars]
Guitar states melody, fast

[Solo 1 - 32 bars]
Guitar improvisation, chromatic runs

[Solo 2 - 32 bars]
Violin solo

[Trading 4s - 16 bars]
Guitar and violin alternate

[Head Out - 32 bars]
Melody restatement, accelerando ending

songs.title: MidnightDrift
songs.sp: Drift Phonk, dark aggressive driving energy, distorted cowbell loop and heavy 808 sub-bass, no vocals. 132 BPM in C minor. Distorted cowbell playing repeating rhythmic pattern as the signature hook. 808 bass with fuzz distortion, heavy sustain, occasional pitch bends downward. Hi-hat triplet rolls with velocity variation. Snare with heavy reverb tail. Dark atmospheric choir sample pitched down, looping in background. Memphis-style vocal chop sample, pitched and chopped. Vinyl degradation texture on the master. Mix is loud, compressed, bass-dominant.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Intro - 4 bars]
Cowbell loop alone, distorted

[Drop 1 - 16 bars]
808 enters, full pattern

[Break - 8 bars]
Choir sample, cowbell continues

[Drop 2 - 16 bars]
Maximum bass, pitched vocal chops

[Break 2 - 8 bars]
Hi-hats alone with cowbell

[Drop 3 - 16 bars]
Final section, most aggressive

[Outro - 4 bars]
Cowbell fades with reverb

songs.title: Squelch303
songs.sp: Acid House, raw 90s rave hypnotic energy, squelchy Roland TB-303 bassline and classic analog drum machine, no vocals. 126 BPM in A minor. The entire track revolves around the 303 bassline with resonance filter sweeps creating the signature squelchy acid sound. Filter cutoff automates throughout — opening during builds, closing during breakdowns. Drum machine: Roland TR-909 style kick drum four-on-the-floor, open hi-hat on every offbeat eighth note, clap on 2 and 4, ride cymbal 16th notes during peaks. No modern production techniques — raw analog sound. Bassline pattern is 16th notes with accent and slide parameters creating the characteristic acid movement. Arrangement builds through filter automation and layering rather than adding new elements. Background: simple stab chord hitting on beats 1 and 3, filtered and reverbed. The track hypnotically loops with subtle variations in the 303 pattern. Structure mimics classic 12-inch house: long intro build, extended main groove, breakdown strip to kick and bass, rebuild to climax, outro strip. Overall mix: loud, punchy kick cutting through, 303 prominent in the mid-bass, hi-hats crisp and bright, minimal processing, warehouse reverb on clap only.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Intro - 32 bars]
Kick alone, then hi-hat enters, 303 filter opening slowly

[Build - 16 bars]
Full drum pattern, 303 resonance increasing

[Main Groove - 64 bars]
Full acid house groove, filter sweeps

[Breakdown - 16 bars]
Kick and 303 only, filter closes

[Rebuild - 16 bars]
Elements return one by one

[Peak - 32 bars]
Maximum resonance, open filter, all elements

[Outro - 32 bars]
Stripping back to kick and fading 303

songs.title: AccordionFiesta
songs.sp: Cumbia, celebratory rolling groove energy, accordion lead melody and guira percussion, joyful female vocals. 98 BPM in C major. Accordion plays melodic lead with ornamental trills. Guira scraping pattern provides constant rhythmic pulse. Conga drums with tumbao pattern. Electric bass playing simple root-fifth pattern. Cowbell marking the clave. Vocals are bright, joyful, call-and-response style with group responses. Mix is warm and live, slight room reverb, instruments well-separated in stereo. Traditional Colombian cumbia arrangement.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro - 8 bars]
Accordion melody alone

[Verse 1]
Bajo el sol de la mañana
The accordion calls to dance
Guira keeps the rhythm rolling
Everybody take a chance

[Chorus]
Fiesta, fiesta, the cumbia plays
Accordion singing through the haze
(Group: ¡Que viva la cumbia!)

[Verse 2]
Feet are moving on the ground
Conga drums speak loud and clear
Every beat a celebration
Joy is all that we know here

[Chorus]
Fiesta, fiesta, the cumbia plays

[Bridge]
Accordion solo over rhythm

[Chorus - Final]
Fiesta, fiesta!

[Outro]
Rhythm fades, accordion trail

songs.title: WallOfSound
songs.sp: Shoegaze, dreamy swirling wall-of-sound energy, heavily distorted reverb-drenched guitars and buried ethereal vocals, breathy androgynous voice. 95 BPM in E major. No dry mix — everything saturated with reverb and delay. Multiple guitar layers: rhythm guitar with chorus pedal and heavy reverb, lead guitar with reverse reverb swells, third guitar with tremolo and fuzz. Bass guitar with flanger creating movement. Drums: simple beat with crash cymbal washes, snare buried in reverb. Vocals are mixed low, buried under the guitar wall, breathy and indistinct. Ethereal, dense, immersive texture where individual instruments blur together into a unified wash of sound.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro - 8 bars]
Reverse guitar swell building

[Verse 1]
(buried, breathy)
Fading into layers deep
Where the sound becomes the sky
Every note dissolves in space
Walls of tone just passing by

[Chorus]
(vocals barely audible over guitars)
Swirling, swirling, lost in sound
Drowning in the beautiful

[Verse 2]
Guitars cascade like waterfalls
Distortion blooming into light
Nothing clear just feeling whole

[Chorus]
Swirling, swirling, lost in sound

[Outro - 16 bars]
All instruments sustain and fade with infinite reverb

songs.title: CallAndResponse
songs.sp: Afrobeats, infectious energetic groove, call-and-response percussion and brass horn stabs, no vocals. 108 BPM in G major. Layered percussion: shaker maintaining eighth-note pulse, log drum providing the bass pattern, djembe accents on offbeats, cowbell on downbeats. Brass section: trumpet and saxophone playing short stab phrases in call-and-response pattern. Guitar: clean electric with palm-muted 16th-note picking pattern. Bass guitar locked with log drum. Arrangement builds by layering percussion one instrument at a time. Warm, live recording feel with natural room sound. Bright and joyful overall energy.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Intro - 8 bars]
Shaker alone, then log drum

[A Section - 16 bars]
Full percussion, guitar enters

[B Section - 16 bars]
Brass stabs, call and response

[Break - 8 bars]
Percussion breakdown

[C Section - 16 bars]
All elements, maximum groove

[Break 2 - 8 bars]
Brass and percussion duet

[Final Section - 16 bars]
Full band, celebratory energy

[Outro - 8 bars]
Strips to shaker and log drum

songs.title: UpliftingArcs
songs.sp: Trance, euphoric uplifting building energy, supersaw synth leads and driving four-on-the-floor kick, no vocals. 140 BPM in A minor resolving to F major in the breakdown. Thick supersaw lead melody playing simple emotional phrases. Kick drum four-on-the-floor with sidechain compression on pads. Rolling bassline with 16th-note pattern. Layered atmospheric pads building tension. Clap on 2 and 4 with heavy reverb. Breakdown: pads only with rising noise sweep and snare roll building 16 bars. Drop: full arrangement returns with maximum supersaw energy. Classic trance arc: build-breakdown-build-peak structure. Mix is bright, wide, with the lead dominating the mid-high frequencies.
songs.lyrics:
[Instrumental]
[Intro - 32 bars]
Kick builds with filtered bass

[Build 1 - 16 bars]
Pads enter, energy rising

[Drop 1 - 32 bars]
Full arrangement, supersaw lead

[Breakdown - 32 bars]
Pads only, emotional, noise sweep building

[Build 2 - 16 bars]
Snare roll, rising tension

[Drop 2 - 32 bars]
Maximum euphoria, key change to F major

[Outro - 32 bars]
Elements remove one by one, kick last
